newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National says maintains progress in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National says maintains progress in Q1.

text.p: British banking and mortgage services group Abbey National said on Thursday that it had maintained its progress in the first quarter of 1997.

Lord Tugendhat, the chairman of Abbey National told an annual meeting that volumes of mortgage business and savings flows in the UK retail banking had "slightly improved" against the last quarter of 1996.
"The UK residential lending market continues to show signs of a pick-up in the first quarter of 1997 compared to this time last year," Lord Tugendhat said.
"Abbey National's expectations of a little over five percent growth in stock of mortgage assets for the market as a whole in 1997 remains unchanged," he added.

Abbey said its life assurance units, Scottish Mutual and Abbey National Life, had performed well in the first quarter with total new premium businesses rising 41 percent over the same period last year.
